purpose: Measure compute-stream FSDP weight-ready waits in the existing resident FI/USP8 baseline.
profile_measurement: pre_forward CUDA events include exposed all-gather waits, weight copy-out and related host submission delay; no per-layer or per-step synchronization. Not a complete no-HSDP counterfactual.
source_changes: None in vllm_omni; opt-in hooks live in framework-validation.
hardware_topology: 8 GPUs, 71.7 GiB reported by nvidia-smi each; PCIe paths within NUMA, SYS across two NUMA nodes, no NVLink shown.
